_doc: Team Deathmatch (2v2, 3v3): unlimited lives. A knocked-out fighter comes back after respawn_seconds on its team's spawn pad (against its own side wall), invulnerable for spawn_protect_seconds or until it attacks. Every KO scores for the other team; first to score_to_win (indexed by fighters per side) wins, or the higher score when time runs out. A tie at time goes to sudden death: the next KO wins. Killing sprees: a KO is credited to the victim's last hitter if that hit landed within credit_seconds. spree_at credited KOs without going down puts a fighter on a spree (level 1, then 2, 3... a KO more each). KOing one is a shutdown: the normal point plus shutdown_bonus per spree level, at most shutdown_cap, and shutdown_energy Surge meter for the killer. The CPU pulls toward a spree fighter by spree_cpu_pull px a level. Times are in ticks (60 per second) unless named _seconds.
